name: Bypass Curve keeps a point the pilot did not edit
step: Check the Bypass Curve half-percent round trip
rationale:
Issue #2782: the FC stores each bypass point in half-percent steps (gov_bypass_throttle / 200 in governorInit(); the Configurator writes x * 2), and Setup > Governor > Bypass Curve shows whole percent. The page wrote all nine points back from their rounded fields on every save, so a stored 12.5 % became 13 % on a save that changed nothing or changed another point, and with #2780 such a save also restarted the FC. The page now writes back only the points the pilot edited since the last read.

The harness drives the real setup_governor_curves.lua with a stand-in runtime: an unchanged save writes every point back as stored, editing one point leaves the half-percent points alone, the edited point is written in half-percent units, and a reload forgets the edits. --self-test restores the write-back of every point and requires the untouched checks to fail.
